post.title: Remotion Studio Starter
post.hook: A video project that is just one package.json and three commands.
post.summary: A bare Remotion starter for making videos with React and TypeScript. Only the package.json exists, so it is a scaffold waiting for compositions.
post.writeup:
**What it is:** a minimal Remotion starter project. The folder holds a single package.json, described as "Simple Remotion starter project".

**Why:** a clean base for programmatic video in React, kept separate from other video experiments.

**How it works:** three scripts cover the loop. `start` runs `npx remotion studio` for live preview. `build` runs `npx remotion render src/index.ts HelloWorld out/video.mp4` to render a composition called HelloWorld. `upgrade` runs `npx remotion upgrade`. Remotion and @remotion/cli are both pinned to 4.0.242, alongside React ^18.3.1 and TypeScript ^5.7.2.

**Findings:** none yet. The build script points at src/index.ts and a HelloWorld composition, but neither is in the folder, and it is not a git repo, so there is no history.

**Open questions:** will this get real compositions, or has it been superseded by other Remotion work?
